Six Companies Launch Joint R&D to Build a Quantum-Computing-Based Materials Development Platform

Project selected by NEDO for innovative materials development platforms using quantum technology

Tokyo – October 28, 2026 – TOPPAN Holdings Inc., AISIN CORPORATION, Asahi Kasei Corporation, SoftBank Corp., AGC Inc., and DIC Corporation jointly announced today that their joint proposal, “Research and Development of Innovative Materials Development Platforms Using Quantum Technology”, has been selected by the New Energy and Industrial Technology Development Organization (NEDO).

Following this selection, the six companies entered into a joint agreement to conduct research and development on constructing a new materials development platform from fiscal 2026 through fiscal 2028.
